drg.description: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease without CC/MCC

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Patient seen and examined at bedside. 45-year-old female admitted for COPD exacerbation. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.82, creatinine 0.99, hemoglobin 13.1, platelets 244, sodium 139, wbc 7.3; vitals dbp 71-76, heart_rate 81-85, map 88-91, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 16-17, sbp 117-123, spo2 95-97, temp 36.9-37.1
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Albuterol-ipratropium nebulizer; Prednisone 40 mg PO
Assessment and plan: COPD exacerbation. Hypertension.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient seen and examined at bedside. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 0.97, hemoglobin 13.2, platelets 243, sodium 139, wbc 6.7; vitals dbp 71-77, heart_rate 82-85, map 86-92, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 15-17, sbp 116-123, spo2 96-97, temp 37-37.2
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Albuterol-ipratropium nebulizer; Prednisone 40 mg PO
Assessment and plan: COPD exacerbation. Hypertension. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 45-year-old female, length of stay 2 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: COPD exacerbation. Hypertension. Follow up with primary care in one week. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed.
